THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
028
STUDY 051
Blue Satin Halter & Pearls
Rights check
Source: 24393.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with blonde hair slicked back
into a low ponytail, with a pale blue satin ribbon tied
around it. She wears a pale blue satin halter top with a
printed pattern and a delicate pearl necklace. Gold drop
earrings and bright blue eyes. Her expression is calm
and composed. A soft blue backdrop with gentle, even
lighting. Palette of powder blue, gold, and ivory.
Polished and feminine, in the style of a runway beauty
close-up.
Polished, feminine, sleek
WORKING NOTES
- The satin ribbon and pearl necklace are the defining
accents.
- Use 'extreme close-up' to focus on the hair and earrings.
Try this: Try an extreme close-up of the hair and earrings.
